name: Competition Specialties Inc.
old_description: Don't miss out on some of the best deals of the year at Comp Specialties Fall Freedom Show!
about:
Competition Specialties Inc., operating as Competition Specialties, LLC, is headquartered in Auburn, Washington. The company was established in 1966 and marks 60 years in business as of 2026. Ownership details beyond the LLC structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm functions as a wholesale distributor of automotive parts and accessories, carrying over 145 major product lines that span offroad, exterior, interior, towing, and adventure categories. It operates four strategically located West Coast warehouses, achieving average fill rates above 94 percent. Services include drop-ship fulfillment, secure real-time internet ordering, a 200-plus-page full-color retail catalog, and a knowledgeable phone sales team. The company also maintains a private-label house brand, CSI Private Label, and runs a Performance Corner Marketing Program for its customers.

Competition Specialties serves jobbers and retailers in the automotive aftermarket, including powersports and adventure-accessory segments. Its customer base consists primarily of wholesale distributors (jobbers) who attend the company's annual jobber-only trade show. Brands carried include Warn, Factor 55, Thule, Rockslide, Streamlight, and Ram Mounts.

The company emphasizes aggressive pricing and unmatched service as its core differentiators, supported by high fill rates, multi-warehouse logistics, and dedicated marketing support for its dealer network.
